requirements.statement: Every S5 coordination sign-off shall be treated as an internal milestone by default.
A coordination sign-off becomes an information exchange only when explicitly identified as such in S7, the BEP deliverable schedule, or a governing MIDP/TIDP entry.
When a milestone is also an exchange, completion of the S5 coordination sign-off is a prerequisite gate for initiating the S7 formal transmittal.
Milestone sign-off confirms coordination readiness; exchange transmittal confirms delivery to external stakeholders.
Internal milestones shall not be transmitted externally without completing the formal exchange packaging defined in S7.
